notes.title: Happy New Year 2017 (and bug fix...)
notes.content:
2016 was a great adventure for us. Thanks for your support!

Our team members are working hard to to deliver more stories in 2017. 

In this version, we've fixed several issues reported by players:
1. Fixed a bug that prevented game from launching on latest macOS.
2. Fixed a bug that might cause fps drop after achievement unlocked.
3. Fixed some grammar errors in English subtitles.

(ver id: 1554342)

See you next time~

notes.title: Bug fix & Known Issue [version 1032536]
notes.content:
we have fixed some problems and will keep on working.
Thank you for staying with us! ː12paperplaneː

[Fixed Issue]
1. Fixed: Cannot unlock the 3rd chapter.
2. Fixed: Some windows users cannot launch the game.
3. Fixed: Cannnot use windowed mode if desktop resoultion smaller than 1024x768.
4. Fixed: Rare crash happened during the gameplay.

[Known Issue]
1. On Mac, game might lose the audio in late game.
Workaround: Save the progress and re-launch the game for now.

2. On Linux, the fullscreen mode cause flickering.
Workaround: Use windowed mode instead for now.

notes.title: Bug Fix & Known Issue [version 1032536]
notes.content:
Thank you for staying with us! :12paperplane:
We have fixed several issues and will keep working on it.

[Fixed Issues]
1. Fixed: Cannot unlock the 3rd chapter.
2. Fixed: Some windows users cannot launch the game.
3. Fixed: Cannnot use windowed mode if desktop resoultion is smaller than 1024x768.
4. Fixed: Rare crash happened during the gameplay.

[Known Issue] We're trying to fix them ASAP.
1. On Mac, game might lose the audio in late game.
Workaround: Save the progress and re-launch the game

2. On Linux, the fullscreen mode cause flickering.
Workaround: Use windowed mode instead of full-screen.

================

If the game still can not launch, please send the dmp files (BKEexception.txt&BKEexception.dmp) and the OS info to thenvlmaker@gmail.com.
We will try our best to fix them!
